training.checkpoint_rule: Final fixed step only; no early stopping, tuning or refit from diagnostics/test results.

primary_metric: Equal-category/condition macro pixel AP over the six shifts within each paired seed
scope: Fixed-setting expanded validation after A1 was selected on cable; previously inspected project categories, not untouched confirmation or SOTA.
restrictions: All training, feature, reference, scoring and precision settings are byte-identical or value-identical to the cable pilot. Only categories, test conditions and compared arms expand.

Reuse the unchanged build_cache, partition and fit_one functions from run_defect_adapter.py; fit A1 afresh for every category/seed. The three cable state hashes must exactly reproduce the previous A1 heads before evaluation.
All nine heads finish normal-only fitting before this run opens test images or labels. No tuning, early stopping, refit, extra shots, synthetic-bank entries or test-time adaptation.
All 126 evaluations are computed afresh. A0 must reproduce all prior E2 scores/metrics; both arms must reproduce overlapping cable pilot results.
Preserve original main, previous branches, source/config files and result folders. Publish on a separate branch.
A1 was chosen using the cable pilot. Report cable separately from bottle/carpet and do not call this an untouched confirmation or proof of novelty for A3.
stability_definition: Report all 9 category/seed six-shift AP differences and all 54 shifted category/seed/condition pairs; strict sign stability means positive mean shifted AP in every category and in every category/seed pair. Report practical gate separately.
